name: UserTesting
description: Connect UserTesting to your AI workflow to build and launch tests, and access customer insights without leaving your tools. Use natural language to generate a test plan, configure and launch a test, and retrieve results from your AI chat interface. Built for designers, product managers, marketers, and researchers who need real customer understanding at AI speed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add UserTesting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add UserTesting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.usertesting.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the UserTesting MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: UserTesting provides these MCP tools: ut___accounts, ut___audiences, ut___check_approval_status, ut___create_test, ut___launch_test, ut___test, ut___test_plan, ut___test_summary, ut___workspaces, and x_amz_bedrock_agentcore_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to UserTesting?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to UserTesting in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
UserTesting requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
UserTesting is developed by UserTesting Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
